title: WMTS (Web Map Tile Service) Provider
description: OGC Web Map Tile Service. Use for tiled services that follow the WMTS standard (fixed tile matrix sets).

body.url: WMTS tile URL template. May contain {TileMatrix}/{TileCol}/{TileRow} or {z}/{x}/{y} placeholders.
body.layer: WMTS layer identifier as defined by the service.
body.matrixSet: Tile matrix set identifier. Use 'EPSG:3857' or 'GoogleMapsCompatible' for Web Mercator (most common).
body.resolutions: Optional array of custom resolution values.
body.matrixIds: Optional array of custom matrix IDs.

examples.description: WMTS layer with standard Web Mercator tile grid

notes: matrixSet 'EPSG:3857' and 'GoogleMapsCompatible' are equivalent for most purposes.
WMTS services often document the tile URL template in their GetCapabilities response.
If the service uses RESTful KVP URLs, use the full URL template in the 'url' field.
